qev-f139b8e08893143bb295bab8.quote: our 2026 CapEx investments are anticipated to be in the range of $175 billion to $185 billion
qev-f139b8e08893143bb295bab8.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google

qev-21c0cde823765aa8b1fa4dfe.quote: To meet customer demand and capitalize on the growing opportunities ahead of us

qev-a899d943511fa9b30740a435.quote: For the full year 2026, we expect CapEx to be in the range of $175 billion to $185 billion, with investments ramping over the course of the year.

qev-5edd372d7c8307c3aa7c0f8d.quote: Keep in mind that the availability of supply, pricing of components, and timing of cash payments can cause some variability in the reported CapEx number.

qev-d21c3a4022f4ce26e8295810.quote: the investments we have been making in AI are already translating to strong performance across the business, as you've seen in our financial results. Our successful execution, coupled with strong performance, reinforces our conviction to make the investments required to further capitalize on the AI opportunity.
qev-d21c3a4022f4ce26e8295810.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi, SVP and CFO, Alphabet and Google

qev-09c155175689c247f2970b94.quote: We're investing in AI compute capacity to support frontier model development by Google DeepMind, ongoing efforts to improve the user experience, and drive higher advertiser ROI in Google Services, significant Cloud customer demand, as well as strategic investments in Other Bets.
qev-09c155175689c247f2970b94.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi, SVP and CFO, Alphabet and Google

qev-46af59427292620d542fe48d.quote: In Google Cloud, we're seeing significant demand for our products and services, which we expect to continue to drive strong growth, despite the tight supply environment we're operating in.

qev-7534360ad371a18889969587.quote: despite the tight supply environment we're operating in

qev-8836faa2ca34a6f5eb215551.quote: the significant increase in our investments in technical infrastructure will continue to put pressure on the P&L in the form of higher depreciation expense and related data centers' operations costs such as energy.
qev-8836faa2ca34a6f5eb215551.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi, SVP and CFO, Alphabet and Google

qev-21db2811fcbefcdef1d03f7c.quote: In 2025, depreciation increased by nearly $6 billion, or 38%, from $15.3 billion in 2024, to $21.1 billion in 2025.

qev-90f648f59d858b6090ba29f6.quote: Given the increase in our CapEx investments in recent years, we expect the growth rate in 2026 depreciation to accelerate in Q1, and meaningfully increase for the full year.

qev-fc324447f55d33c128bde1d7.quote: Approximately 60% of our investment in 2025, and it's going to be fairly similar in 2026, went towards machines; so, the servers.
